# Dealer management for independent used car dealers

An open-source **dealer management system (DMS)** for small independent used car dealers,
California first: inventory, deals, compliance gates and records, with security built in.

> **Status: early development (Phase 1).** It is run locally with **synthetic data only** and is
> **not ready for real deals or real customer data.** Nothing here is legal advice; see
> [NOTICE-NOT-LEGAL-ADVICE.md](NOTICE-NOT-LEGAL-ADVICE.md).

## Why
Small dealers pay monthly for closed systems that update compliance on the vendor's schedule. This
project keeps a **public, dated and cited model of what the law requires** (for example the
California CARS Act, SB 766) and enforces it as gates and deadlines in the workflow.

## Getting started (developers)
Requirements: Node 22, pnpm, Docker, `gh`, and gitleaks ≥ 8.19.

```bash
scripts/setup.sh   # checks tools, installs git hooks and dependencies
pnpm verify        # lint + typecheck + tests
```

More commands (local database, seed data, the web app) arrive as the foundation plan is built. See
[CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md) for the command table and [docs/](docs/) for the design, plans and decisions.
